Consent.text: We use the Meta pixel to measure the effectiveness of our Facebook and Instagram ads: it is active as soon as you arrive, and you can refuse it here or at any time. Audience measurement (Google Analytics) is only turned on with your consent.
Consent.essentialText: Cart, language, sign-in, security. Essential, always on, no audience tracking.
Consent.analyticsText: Page views and journeys, to improve the shop. Aggregated data, no Google advertising.
Consent.marketingText: Measures Facebook and Instagram ads (page views, add-to-carts, orders).
